name: roguelike-td-monorepo
description: 联机肉鸽塔防（Cocos Creator 3.8 + TypeScript）— 工程总入口

scripts.build:shared: cd shared && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:tools: cd RoguelikeClient && npm install && node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
